bed-soru-kubbe.soru: How many domes cover the Bedesten?
ipuclari: Count the domes in two rows in the photograph taken from above.
bed-soru-kubbe.dogru_metin: Fourteen domes on six piers cover the Bedesten's central space of 15.00 × 56.50 metres.
bed-soru-kubbe.yanlis_metin: Try again. You can ask for a hint below.

bed-saha-kapi.evden: Tap the Bedesten's gates in the 3D model.
bed-saha-kapi.tamam_metin: The Bedesten is entered through gates on its four façades; each opens into a domed entrance space.
